details: `base64-x58` is a copy of the `base-x` encoding library (package.json still points at the cryptocoinjs/base-x repository) with one obfuscated statement injected at the start of `decode()` (`src/cjs/index.cjs`, `src/esm/index.js`). Every call to `decode()` POSTs the input string to a hardcoded Telegram bot (bot8177895028, chat 7631491367). Base58 `decode()` input is typically a wallet private key. The same bot is hardcoded in `node-bs58.js` 4.0.2-4.0.6; imported by `node-bs58.js` 6.0.0 and `npm-bs58.js` 6.0.0.
